verdict.rationale: Vercel Sandbox ships an official SDK, `@vercel/sandbox` for JavaScript and TypeScript, and its docs call the Sandbox SDKs the recommended integration path. The SDK provides programmatic creation, command execution, file management, timeout extension and automatic snapshotting. missing for 10: explicitly named SDKs beyond JS/TS (the plural 'SDKs' implies more but none are listed), detailed API reference coverage, and independent or hands-on corroboration of the SDK.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can build against official SDKs

citations.quote: The Sandbox SDKs are the recommended way to integrate Vercel Sandbox into your applications. They provide a programmatic interface to create sandboxes, run commands, and manage files.
You can configure this using the `timeout` option when creating a sandbox, and extend it using `sandbox.extendTimeout()`.
when a sandbox stops, the SDK automatically snapshots its filesystem
